Hi Alex,

Sorry we missed each other for the technical deep dive this morning — I was on the call and saw the other attendee drop off. No worries, I know schedules get tight. I want to make sure we get the right folks from our side (SE + infra) on the call so we can cover latency, batching, and integration surface area.

Tight windows that work for our SEs this week (PT):
- Tue 2026-05-11, 10:00–10:45 (30–45 min)
- Wed 2026-05-12, 16:00–16:45 (30–45 min)
If neither works I can free up Fri morning (preferred fallback). Can you confirm one of these by EOD tomorrow so I can lock the calendar? We had a couple of other requests for SE time, so I need a quick yes/no to guarantee availability.

Proposed 30-minute agenda:
- 5m intros & business goals
- 10m architecture + latency/throughput targets
- 10m demo: integration paths (API, embeddings, batch inference)
- 5m next steps (POC runway, data handling/security checklist)

Attaching the draft agenda and our standard MAP SOW to speed the contracting discussion if we decide to run a short POC.

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation either way.

Marcus Lin

One ask: can we loop in our security lead on the call? Please include a short security kickoff section (5–7 min) so we can quickly cover SOC2 scope and data handling. I'll also attach our SOC2 questionnaire so you can preview it ahead of time.

I've updated the agenda to add a 7-minute security kickoff as requested. Please share the security lead's name/email so we can add them to the invite.

Calendar invite (provisional) here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123 — I'll send the confirmed invite once you send a quick yes on the security contact.

Updated attachments: agenda with security slot.

- If you have latency SLOs or token-cost guardrails, paste them in your reply so Dev can tailor the demo to realistic workloads.

Thanks — locking this down will make it easier to schedule SE time.
